# Engineering Knowledge Package Contract

## Required Sections

1. Question
2. Retrieval Path
3. Retrieved Objects
4. Executive Summary
5. Decision Guidance
6. Relevant Concepts
7. Relevant Patterns
8. Quality Attribute Impact
9. Examples
10. Sufficiency Statement
11. Limitations
12. Sources

## Rule

Engineering Knowledge Packages are generated artifacts.

They must not be committed as canonical knowledge.
